meta.title: TenthMatrix: the AI-first agent development agency. 10x faster teams.
meta.description: TenthMatrix is an AI-first agent development agency. We set up AI agents in the process automation of each business to sell, market and run the back office, and we promise a 10x increase in your staff's productivity.

hero.title: AI agents that make your team 10x faster
hero.lede: We map the processes in your business and set up AI agents to automate them: agents that sell, market and run your back office. We promise a 10x increase in your staff's productivity. The agents do the repetitive work, your people make the decisions.

name.title: TenthMatrix means 10x faster
name.body: The name is the promise: a 10x increase in productivity. For each business we map the processes, set up agents to automate them and measure one number: is each person the agents work for ten times more productive at the job? If the pilot does not show it, we change the agents before the full build.
points: Every process mapped, automated and measured before and after
Agents draft and do; a person approves what matters
Code, data and keys stay yours

pillars.title: Agents that sell, market and run your back office
pillars.lede: We are an agent agency first: we start from the work your staff do every day and build agents that take it off their desks.

sales.title: Sales agents
sales.body: Qualify inbound leads, research accounts, draft follow-ups and keep the CRM up to date, so your sales team spends its time talking to buyers.

marketing.title: Marketing agents
marketing.body: Plan, draft and publish content, social posts and campaigns in your brand voice, then report on what worked, with a person signing off before anything goes live.

backoffice.title: Back-office agents
backoffice.body: Work through invoices, orders, inboxes, tickets and reports across your ERP, finance and support systems, and stop for review before anything is sent, spent or deleted.

benefits.title: What you get when our agents do the work
benefits.lede: Each benefit maps to software we build and run ourselves, so you can inspect it before you sign anything.
benefits.all: Compare with in-house and chatbot SaaS

approval.title: A person approves what matters
approval.body: Agents draft and prepare. Anything that sends, spends or deletes waits for a named person.

hosting.title: Self-hosted or managed
hosting.body: Run the agents in your own cloud or data centre, or have us run them. The code is the same either way.

data.title: Your data and keys stay with you
data.body: Data stays in your systems and model keys stay in your secrets store. Pick the model provider, or host an open-weight model yourself.

vault.title: Secrets isolated per agent
vault.body: WSL Vault issues short-lived, scoped credentials, encrypted per tenant and recorded in a tamper-evident audit log.

releases.title: Releases gated on health
releases.body: Ring Promoter moves each change from int to prod only when health checks pass, and rolls back when they fail.

edge.title: Security at the edge
edge.body: Proxy10x puts an API gateway, WAF rules and rate limits in front of the agent and the tools it calls.

observe.title: Cost and behaviour you can see
observe.body: A trace for every run, cost and latency per agent, and alerts when either drifts.

production.title: Built by a team that runs agents
production.body: Our own agents run in production on this stack. We publish how they work, including what broke.

steps.title: Discovery, pilot, build, then run or hand over
steps.lede: Each stage ends with something you keep, even if you stop there.

items.title: Discovery
items.body: We pick one job, the systems it touches and who checks the result, and write down what the agent must never do. You get a written scope and a fixed quote for the pilot.

items.title: Pilot
items.body: The smallest version that does the real job on real data, behind approval gates, measured against the scope. Then a go, change or stop recommendation.

items.title: Build
items.body: Production code, integrations, secrets, guardrails, tests and a release path, all in your repository. You can read every prompt, trace and test.

items.title: Run or hand over
items.body: We operate it with monitoring, cost reports and a regular review, or hand it to your team with runbooks and training.

engagement.title: Four ways to work with us
engagement.lede: Choose by how clear the job is and how much you want to own at the end.

fixed.title: Fixed-scope project
fixed.body: One agent, application or integration, with a written scope and an agreed price for it.

team.title: Dedicated agent team
team.body: A small team working through your backlog of AI work, month by month.

embedded.title: Embedded engineers
embedded.body: Our engineers join your team, work in your repos and pass on what they know.

transfer.title: Build, operate, transfer
transfer.body: We build it, run it for an agreed period, then hand it over with runbooks and training.

products.title: Software we build and run ourselves
products.lede: Client agents run on the same products we use in production. Each one started as something our own agents needed.

ringPromoter.description: Promotes every release through int, test, acc and prod rings. Health gates decide, and failed checks roll back on their own.

proxy10x.description: Sits in front of your origins with live configuration, an edge cache and WAF rules. An MCP gateway for agents is on the roadmap.

wslVault.description: Envelope encryption with a key hierarchy per tenant, dynamic leases and a tamper-evident audit log. Steal the server, not the secrets.

jobshout.description: Specialist agents that work in Gmail, GitHub and live sites, stream every step and stop for your approval before anything goes out.

jev.description: Our independent series and benchmark lab on fast decision models, agent harnesses, routing and the cost of inference.

nebula.name: Nebula family
nebula.description: Rust infrastructure for agent workloads, from NebulaDB, a database with vector search and streaming RAG, to NebulaDNS, authoritative DNS with Prometheus metrics.

brandPage.title: The Lattice system
brandPage.lede: Logo, colour, type and components for TenthMatrix, shown in both themes. This page is the design review surface and is not indexed.
brandPage.logoLede: Nine cells and one more: the grid is the model, the tenth cell is the agent. The mark stays crisp at 16 px.
brandPage.paletteLede: Ink on paper, one signal. Ratios are WCAG 2.2 contrast against the theme background (text and controls) or the theme text colour (surfaces).
brandPage.contrastNote: Text needs 4.5:1, control borders 3:1. Hairlines are decorative.
brandPage.typeLede: Bricolage Grotesque for display, Instrument Sans for body and UI, IBM Plex Mono for code, data and eyebrows.
brandPage.componentsLede: Buttons, pills, cards, form controls, code and article typography, side by side in light and dark.
brandPage.iconsLede: One set, one stroke weight, accent only for the active item.
